messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream (eu-west-1). 3 consecutive p99 breaches over 5m. Auto-pager triggered: tier0-oncall. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/streaming-p99>
ben_oncall: I'm paged, I'm on it. Starting quickcheck dashboards now.
alice_sre: seeing p99 ~3.8s, p95 ~1.2s for streaming connections. Error rate stable, but streaming tail stalls visible. KV cache hit rate dropped from ~92% -> ~60% over last 6m.
carlos_eng: any recent infra or model deploys? @frank_release do you see anything in deploy history around 08:00 UTC?
frank_release: no full prod rollout in the streaming pool since last night. There was a config job at 07:58 that adjusted proxy keepalive, it was automatically rolled back at 08:05 due to health checks.
alice_sre: please run quick evictions check and proxy mem pressure: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=stream-proxy --since=10m | grep -i eviction` and `curl -s http://proxy-metrics/eu-west-1 | jq .memory`.
ben_oncall: running those now. Also checking autoscaler events and any recent routing changes.
dana_support: customer-impact: one enterprise customer reported multiple stalls and hung streams (no 5xx). Small number of tickets but high severity for those sessions. CS alerted.
erin_pm: are we seeing cross-region reroutes or an edge flapping that might explain sudden KV cache misses?
alice_sre: dashboard snapshot pasted:
```
metric: streaming.request.p99
region eu-west-1: baseline 0.9s -> spike window 08:12-08:18 p99 3.8s
kv_cache_hit_percent: 92 -> 60 -> 48 (last 3 samples)
active_streams: flat
backend_cpu: no spike
```
ben_oncall: I initiated a partial route-shift to eu-west-2 (falls back to quantized model variant) for 15% of traffic as a mitigation. Will keep rate low and observe.
carlos_eng: also enabling prefix cache warmup on the streaming proxies and scaling pool by +3 replicas:
```
POST /admin/scale
{"replicas": 12}
```
incidents-bot: Mitigation note: fallback routing enabled to model-quantized-v2 in eu-west-2. Canary shift initiated.
ben_oncall: early signal: p99 in eu-west-1 improving to ~1.6s after routing change. kv cache hit still recovering. Monitoring for 10m.
alice_sre: next runbook steps: capture KV cache dump (`/admin/kvcache/dump`), gather traces for requests in spike window, check for throttling on prefix eviction, collect proxy oom events.
dana_support: I'll send a status note to affected customers: ETA ~30m for stable recovery, include mitigation steps. Any customer-facing action items?
erin_pm: please include explanation that we routed a portion of traffic to a fallback region/model and are collecting a post-incident report.
ben_oncall: muting noisy alerts for now (keep pager if p99 >2s for next 30m). Logging handoff to alice_sre; I'm out in ~8m.
alice_sre: taking over live mitigation and postmortem. I'll create incident doc and add the traces + timelines. If anyone sees re-regression please @alice_sre and escalate to SRE lead.
ben_oncall: thanks team — initial mitigation effective, will follow up in incident doc. :thumbsup:
